\caption{W2 test on Qwen3.5-9B: referring segmentation cIoU per split. Qwen3.5-9B on the five W2 test splits (1,000 expressions each, the E1 polygon subset); cIoU $\times$100 with 95\% bootstrap CI over expressions (1,000 resamples, as computed by each run). cIoU = summed intersection / summed union. Own box: the model's own box (E1 protocol) as the mask; W1-F: that box plus the default GrabCut candidate (a fixed pipeline, no LLM decision); random / oracle pick: a random / the ground-truth-best of the four tool candidates; W2-a: the frozen model picks a candidate (zero-shot; candidate 1 = W1-F, also submitted when the pick fails to parse); W2-c: LoRA text supervision to propose the box and pick; W2-c + replay: W2-c trained with self-distillation replay (post hoc variant, descriptive). E1 zero-shot polygon: all 1,000 outputs per split fail to parse (strict scoring gives 0). Paired differences (points $\times$100): per-expression paired bootstrap of the ratio of sums, 95\%, 10,000 resamples; pooled = the five splits together (5,000 expressions). Per-system pooled cIoU is not part of the analysis, so the pooled column has differences only. External baseline LLMSeg (official code, commit f2191e6) driven by the same Qwen3.5-9B, zero-shot, on 300 hash-selected expressions per split (pooled 1,500), with W2-c on the same expressions alongside. Before refinement = after its first two stages; after refinement = its main configuration. Model calls per image (split means): 13.5–14.0 after vs. 2.0 before refinement; W2-c 2. LLMSeg $-$ W2-c: paired bootstrap, 95\%, 1,000 resamples; the pooled LLMSeg and W2-c readings have no CI in the analysis. Data: RUN-0072, RUN-0076, RUN-0078 (LLMSeg comparison computed on CPU, D139); W2-a paired differences completed in RUN-0081.}
